suite: executor/workspace/tools race with actual Seatbelt, Docker and public dependency qualification
qualificationLimits: Docker storage is monitored at 2 GiB, not a hard filesystem quota.
Native macOS executor remains restricted to qualified single-process execution.
Source writeback is journaled with full-manifest preflight; external editor changes can still race a multi-file commit and produce explicit recovery conflict.
Dependency setup uses public hash-locked packages with scripts disabled; separately approved offline lifecycle commands use ordinary governed run_command.
